newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila share index jumps 1.08 pct in mid-trade.
newsitem.headline: Manila share index jumps 1.08 pct in mid-trade.

text.p: The Manila share index rose by 29.50 points, or 1.08 percent, to 2,752.17 in late trade on Thursday due to a resurgence of buying in blue chip issues, traders said.
"At first, the market was hesitant and then we saw some follow-through buying and strength on firstliners," said Juanis Barredo, analyst at Citisecurities Inc.
Traders said the market was choppy in early trading, with investors cautious about entering the market only hours before the release of first quarter GNP figures.
In midsession, blue chips Petron Corp, Ayala Corp and Ayala Land Inc which were quiet in early trade joined Meralco B as active gainers.

"We are seeing healthy accumulation at these levels and those that are buying aggressively are positioning ahead of the GNP figures. Normally, there will be a sell on news even if the figure is within expectations," said Nathan Lozada, assistant vice-president at Philippine Asia Equity.
Turnover was still light at 730 million pesos an hour before trading ended.
